name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Experimental input assistant: buffers clicks that would kill you and protects directional releases.

predictive-buffer.name: Predictive input buffer
predictive-buffer.description: If the next frame would put you inside a hazard, hold the click until a safe frame inside the window.

buffer-in-cube-mode.name: Buffer in ground modes (cube, ball, robot, spider)
buffer-in-cube-mode.description: Off by default: delaying a jump in a gravity mode can make a required jump impossible to land. Flight modes (ship, UFO, wave, swing) are always buffered.

window-size.name: Buffer window (frames)
window-size.description: How many frames ahead a click may be delayed on normal sections. One frame = one GJBaseGameLayer::update call.

extended-window-size.name: Extended window (frames)
extended-window-size.description: Bigger window used on dense sections (when enough hazards are nearby).

density-threshold.name: Density threshold
density-threshold.description: Number of nearby hazards that switches the buffer from the base window to the extended window.

scan-radius.name: Scan radius (units)
scan-radius.description: Only hazards whose centre is within this distance of the player are considered by the predictor.

prediction-mode.name: Prediction mode
prediction-mode.description: aabb = one linear extrapolation from current velocity (fast). trajectory = per-frame integration with gravity (slower, follows arcs better).

humanization-chance.name: Earliest-safe chance (%)
humanization-chance.description: Chance to pick the earliest safe frame. The rest of the time a random safe frame is used, to avoid identical input patterns.

release-protection.name: Directional release protection
release-protection.description: Delay releasing Left/Right while airborne in flying modes, to avoid dropping out of a wave or dash one tick too early.

release-delay-ms.name: Release delay (ms)
release-delay-ms.description: How long a Left/Right release is held back. 0 disables the delay.

debug-logs.name: Debug logs
debug-logs.description: Print per-click buffer decisions and a session summary (buffered clicks, average delay) to the Geode console.
